S: piṃsati：[piś，piṃś] ① 飾る，鳴る．② 砕く，搗（つ）く，打つ．pr．3pl．piṃsare； pp．piṃsa，piṭṭha ①．
P: Piṁsati，2 [piṣ or piṁṣ，Vedic pinaṣṭi，cp．Lat．pinso to grind，pīla=pestle，pistillum=pistil； Lith．paisýti to pound barley； Gr．ptiζsw id．； Ohg．fesa=Nhg．fese] 1．to grind，crush，pound J．I，452； II，363； IV，3 （matthakaṁ），440 （akaluñ candanañ ca silāya p．）； Miln．43； DhA．III，184 （gandhe piṁsissati； BB pisissati）．-- 2．to knock against each other，make a sound J．V，202：see piṁsati1．-- pp．piṁsa & piṭṭha1．See also pisati and paṭi°．（Page 456）

Piṁsati，1 [piś or piṁś，cp．Vedic piṁśati，with two bases viz．Idg．*peig，as in P．piñjara & pingala； Lat．pingo to paint，embroider； and *peik，as in Sk．piṁśati，peśaḥ； Av．paes- to embellish； Gr．poikiλos many-coloured； Goth．fēh，Ags．fāh id．See detail in Walde，Lat．Wtb．under pingo] to adorn，form，embellish； orig．to prick，cut．Perhaps piṁsare （3．pl．med．） J．V，202 belongs here，in meaning “tinkle，sound” （lit．prick），expld in C．by viravati．Other der．see under pingala．piñjara，pesakāra．（Page 456）

DOP: piṃsati ( and, esp. in Be pisati 2 , ( and piṃseti 1 ?) pr. 3 sg. [ S. pinaṣṭi], 1. grinds; crushes; pounds; Dhātup 321 (piṃsa saṃcuṇṇane); Dhātum 620; Ja IV 440, 24* (agaḷuṃ candanaṃ ca silāya ~āmi); Sp 177, 32 (taṃ [patthapulakaṃ] āyasmā Ānando āharitvā silāyaṃ ~ati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisati); Dhp-a III 184, 21 (ekekā khattiyadhītā nisīditvā gandhe ~issati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisissati); Vibh-a 105, 1 (paridevanto hi … ubhohi hatthehi uraṃ paharati ~ati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisati); Sadd 473, 12 (pisa cuṇṇane: ~ati piṃsako); — part.pr. ( a ) piṃsanta, pisanta, mfn. , Ja V 271, 2´ (te satte saṇhakaraṇiyaṃ tile ~anto viya, Ce, Se so; Ee tilaṃ; Be pisanto); Sp 847, 35 (mulabhesajjādīni ~antānaṃ vā koṭṭentānaṃ vā, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee pisantānaṃ); ( b ) piṃsamāna, pisamāna, mfn. , Ja III 377, 26 (itthiṃ … gandhaṃ ~amānaṃ disvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisamānaṃ); IV 3, 28 (khuracakkaṃ tassa sīse khipi taṃ tassa matthakaṃ ~amānaṃ bhassi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisamānaṃ); — 2. rubs noisily together; ? Ja V 202, 26* (tā ~are carato māṇavassa cirītisaṅghā-r-iva pāvusamhi, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se saṃsare; 206, 1´ foll.: tāni piḷandhanāni pāvuse navavaṭṭhe deve cirīṭisaṅghā viya viravanti); — absol. piṃsitvā, pisitvā, Vin III 6, 28 (patthapulakaṃ silāyaṃ ~itvā, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee pisitvā); Ja II 363, 9 (siṅgiverajīrakādīni ~itvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisitvā); Mil 43, 18 (mūlabhesajjāni ~itvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisitvā); Vism 345, 21 (saṇhakaraṇiyaṃ piṃsitvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisitvā); Sv 614, 29 (gandhā taṃ muhuttaṃ pisitvā ṭhapitā viya, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pisetvā); Ps V 67, 1 (kappāsaṃ … sahatthen’ eva pisitvā pothetvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee piṃsetvā); Nidd-a I 397, 23 (gandhajātaṃ ~itva gandhamagganā viya, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se nipisitvā) = Vibh-a 485, 22 ( Ce, Se so; Be nipisitvā; Ee ~etvā; = Vism 29, 25 : Be nipisitvā; Ce, Ee nipiṃsitvā; Se nippiṃsitvā); — pass. part.pr. piṃsiyamāna, mfn. , Vibh-a 156, 17 (~iyamānāya pana makkhikāya, Ce, Ee so; Be pisiyamānāya; Se ~ayamānāya); — pp ( a ) piṭṭha ( and pīṭha ?) mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) ground; pounded; crushed; Abh 1075 (~aṃ tu cuṇṇite); Vin I 203, 17 (bhikkhū ~āni añjanāni thālikesu pi sarāvakesu pi nikkhipanti); Ja III 425, 19* (~ā tilā); Sp 576, 15 (~assa viya gandhassa paṭipiṃsanaṃ, Ce, Se so; Ee piṃsitassa; Be pisitassa … paṭipisanaṃ); 1092, 4 (tilakakkena attho ti ~ehi tilehi attho); — 2. ( n. ) anything ground, esp. flour; pounded grain; a flour paste; dough; Vin I 210, 3 (guḷe ~aṃ pi chārikaṃ pi pakkhipante); Ja I 347, 25 (sā thokaṃ yeva ~aṃ kapallapātiyaṃ pakkhipi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee piṭṭhiṃ) = Dhp-a I 371, 3 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee piṭṭhiṃ); Ja III 314, 23 (bhattakārako kākassa pattāni luñcitvā ~ena taṃ makkhetvā); V 271, 9´ (~aṃ viya sarīraṃ sedeti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pīṭhaṃ); Vism 657, 13 (suppagge ~aṃ vaṭṭayamānaṃ viya); Sp 475, 15 (~ena vā mattikāya vā rūpaṃ katva); 837, 17 (sattannaṃ tāva dhaññānaṃ dhaññānulomānaṃ aparaṇṇānaṃ ca ~aṃ); — ~ôdaka, n. , flour mixed with water; Ja I 220, 21 (cīvaraṃ … ~ôdakena rajitvā); Sp 621, 10 ; Ps III 238, 16 (tayo māse ~ôdaken’ eva yāpesi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se patthodanen’ eva); — ~-khali, f. , flour paste; Sp 1219, 5 (~-maddan ti ~-khaliṃ); — ~-dhītalikā, f. , a paste doll; Pv-a 16, 22 (dārikāya dhāti ~-dhītalikaṃ adāsi ayaṃ te dhītā imaṃ gahetvā kīḷassū ti … ekadivasaṃ … patitvā bhijji, Be, Ee katapiṭṭhadhītalikaṃ; Ee dhātī katapiṭṭhaṃ dhītalikaṃ adāsi); — ~-paṭa, m. , cloth stiffened with paste; Vism 75, 29 (sākhāmaṇḍapo pi ~-paṭo pi, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee pīṭha-; Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 100, 5 : pīṭhapaṭo khalitthaddhasāṭako); — ~-piṇḍi, f. , ~-piṇḍa, m.n. , ~-piṇḍaka, m. , a ball of dough; a cake; Ja I 503, 6 (tasmiṃ ukkhaliyaṃ ~-piṇḍi viya antokucchiyaṃ sijjamāne, Be, Ce so; Ee ~-piṇḍī; Se ~-piṇḍaṃ); Vism 260, 16 (cattāro ~-piṇḍā viya) ≠ Pj I 60, 12 (~-piṇḍikā); Vism 359, 10 (purāṇalābukaṭāhe pakkhittāya ~-piṇḍiyā); Sv 434, 5 (patitamattā va accantakhāre udake ~-piṇḍi viya vilīyanti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se ~-piṇḍaṃ) = Ps IV 178, 17 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~-piṇḍe); — ~-madda, n. , flour paste; Vin II 151, 17 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ikkāsaṃ ~-maddan ti); Ja III 226, 11* (vilūnaṃ sūdaputtena ~-maddena makkhitaṃ, so read ? Be ~-maṇḍena; Ce, Ee piṭṭhimaddena; Se ~-maṭṭhena); Sp 1219, 4 ; — pp ( b ) piṃsita , pisita, mfn. , ground; pounded; crushed; Ja IV 250, 11 (so saṇhakaraṇiyaṃ ~o viya, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisito); Vism 260, 5 (nisadāya ~am iva saṇhabhāvaṃ āpajjitvā, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee pisitaṃ iva) = Vibh-a 243, 11 ( Se so; Be, Ce, Ee pisitam iva); Th-a III 191, 28 (makkhena pisitattā makkhī, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pisitā); — apiṃsita, apisita, mfn. , It-a II 59, 6 (yaṃ kiñci gandhajātaṃ piṃsitaṃ apiṃsitaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pisitaṃ apisitaṃ); — supiṃsita, supisita, mfn. , well-ground; Sv 626, 36 (supiṃsitassa … haricandanassa, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se supisitassa) = Ps IV 228, 5 ( Ce so; Be, Se supisitassa; Ee wr sapiṃsitassa); — fpp piṃsitabba, mfn. , Sp 1091, 5 (piṃsitabbehi, Ee, Se so; Be pisitabbehi; Ce omits ); — caus. ( a ) aor. 3 sg. piṃsayī, Ap 300, 6 ; 1 sg. apiṃsayiṃ, Ap 300, 4 ; — ( b ) pr. 3 sg. piṃsāpeti, piṃsāpayati, Mil 149, 20 (khāralavaṇaṃ nisadāya piṃsāpeyya, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisāpeyya); — absol. ( a ) piṃsāpetvā, Dhp-a IV 189, 13 (bahucandanaṃ piṃsāpetvā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be pisāpetvā); Pj II 523, 31 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pisāpetvā); ( b ) piṃsāpayitvā, Mhv 30:9; — see also cīnapiṭṭha, paṭipiṃsati.
